rule: Generated by shared/services/child-test/sa/build.js; never edit by hand. Every item and option comes from item-bank.v3.json (src); Jugnu's lines adapt the official EGRA/EGMA wording for self-administration (sa/scripts.js, from).

conventions.tasks: keyed "<form>/<task>"; task = the v3 block id (legacy_block), plus <lang>.story_comp for the story questions
conventions.modes: tap: Jugnu says the target, the child taps it (options) or types it (keypad), scored on the phone; record: audio kept, scored later by the child-test scorer
conventions.stop: first_row n: no correct item in the first n → stop (EGRA); first_line n: no correct word in the first line (n words); consecutive_errors n (Core EGMA); time_limit_s: the clock
conventions.feedback: correct/wrong feedback on practice items only; scored items get none (EGRA)
conventions.audio: keys sa/v1/<lang>/<sha1(lang|text)[0,12]>.mp3 under SA_AUDIO_BASE; a missing clip falls back to the browser's speech of the same text
conventions.digits: maths shows Western digits; Urdu speech uses Urdu digits (v3 convention)
conventions.translation: Urdu renderings of English scripts are pending native review (v3 convention)

passage.text: کل عائشہ کے اسکول میں صفائی کا دن تھا۔ تمام بچوں نے اپنی کلاس صاف کی۔ عائشہ نے میزوں کو کپڑے سے صاف کیا اور کوڑا ڈبے میں ڈالا۔ اس کی سہیلی نے دیواروں پر لگے چارٹ سیدھے کیے۔ جب استاد آئے تو کلاس بہت صاف تھی۔ استاد نے بچوں کی محنت کی تعریف کی۔ سب بچے خوش نظر آئے۔

items.rubric: Correct if the child says it was the cleaning day (صفائی کا دن).

prompt.text: عائشہ نے کیا صاف کیا؟

items.rubric: Correct if the child says the tables/desks (میزیں). The whole class, the walls or the charts are wrong.

prompt.text: سہیلی نے کیا سیدھا کیا؟

prompt.text: استاد نے کس چیز کی تعریف کی؟

items.rubric: Correct if the child says the children's hard work (محنت). A clean class alone is wrong: the question asks what was praised.

prompt.text: کلاس صاف ہونے کے بعد استاد خوش کیوں ہوئے؟

items.rubric: Correct if the child links the happiness to the clean class or the children's effort. A circular answer ("because they were happy") is wrong.

passage.text: Sara woke up early on Sunday. Her mother asked her to buy bread from the shop near their home. Sara took some money and walked with her brother. The shopkeeper gave her fresh bread in a bag. On the way back, they saw a small kitten. Sara smiled and ran home happily. She gave the bread to her mother quickly.

prompt.text: On what day did Sara wake up early?

items.rubric: Correct if the child says Sunday (in English or Urdu).

prompt.text: What did her mother ask her to buy?

items.rubric: Correct if the child says bread (in English or Urdu).

prompt.text: Who walked with Sara to the shop?

items.rubric: Correct if the child says her brother (in English or Urdu).

prompt.text: What did they see on the way back?

items.rubric: Correct if the child says a kitten or a small cat (in English or Urdu).

prompt.text: Why did Sara run home happily?

items.rubric: Correct if the child gives a happy or excited reason, or links it to the kitten or getting the bread, as in the RWP key. Fear or lateness is wrong.

prompt.text: Why did Sara take money with her?

items.rubric: Correct if the child says the money was to buy or pay for the bread (in English or Urdu).

Imran dug a hole, put the plant in the soil and put water in it slowly. The teacher was happy with his work. His friends clapped for him.

prompt.text: Why did Imran wake up early?

items.rubric: Correct if the child says for school (in English or Urdu).

prompt.text: What was the class planting?

items.rubric: Correct if the child says trees or plants. An answer in Urdu or English is accepted.

prompt.text: What did Imran take in a bag?

items.rubric: Correct if the child says a plant or a small plant (a small or baby tree is the same thing). Just "tree" / درخت repeats question 1 and is not enough. Books, food, water, seeds or soil are wrong. An answer in Urdu or English is accepted.

prompt.text: What did Imran put in the soil?

items.rubric: Correct if the child says the plant (in English or Urdu). Water alone is wrong: water went in after the plant.

prompt.text: Why was the teacher happy with Imran?

accept: he showed the class how to plant it
he put water in the plant
اس نے کلاس کو پودا لگانا سکھایا
he put the plant in the soil
اس نے اچھی طرح پودا لگایا
اس نے پودا مٹی میں لگایا
items.rubric: Correct if the child gives any reason linked to Imran's planting work: he did good work, planted it well, showed the class how, or names a step he did (dug a hole, put the plant in the soil, watered it). Bringing a plant, or waking early, is wrong. An answer in Urdu or English is accepted.

prompt.text: Why did his friends clap for him?

accept: because he did a good job
items.rubric: Correct if the child links the clapping to Imran's planting or good work, as in the RWP key.

prompt.text: You have 3 biscuits. Sana gives you 3 more. How many biscuits do you have now?
There are 4 children on a bus. 2 are boys. The rest are girls. How many girls are on the bus?
Zoya has 3 oranges. Sara has 2 oranges. How many more oranges does Sara need to have the same number of oranges as Zoya?
Ahmed puts 4 balls in a bag. Now there are 25 balls in the bag. How many balls were in the bag to begin with?
There are 5 girls and 25 bananas. The girls share the bananas equally. How many bananas does each girl get?
Salman has 2 boxes of toy cars. Each box has 4 cars in it. How many cars does Salman have in total?
There are three children on the bus. One child gets out of the bus. How many children are left on the bus?
